Address: Ripon Building, EVR Periyar Salai, Chennai - 600003
AboutDescription: Greater Chennai Corporation is the largest municipal corporation in Tamil Nadu. It was established in 1688 and is one of the oldest municipal bodies in India. It covers an area of 426 sq km and serves over 70 lakh residents across Chennai city.

Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation is known as the Manchester of South India due to its thriving textile and engineering industries. It is the second largest corporation in Tamil Nadu and covers 246 sq km.
Madurai City Municipal Corporation governs the ancient temple city of Madurai in Tamil Nadu. Known for the Meenakshi Amman Temple
column18: it is one of the oldest living cities in the world and the cultural capital of Tamil Nadu.

AboutDescription: Tiruchirappalli City Municipal Corporation (Trichy) is a major city in Tamil Nadu situated at the centre of the state. Known for the Rock Fort Temple and as an educational hub with NIT Trichy and Bharathidasan University.

Address: Corporation Building, Saradha College Road, Salem - 636001
AboutDescription: Salem City Municipal Corporation is known as the Steel City of Tamil Nadu due to the Salem Steel Plant. It is also famous for mango production and silk weaving. The corporation covers an area of 87 sq km.
Tirunelveli City Municipal Corporation governs the southern city of Tirunelveli
column18: famous for Halwa and the Nellaiappar Temple. The city is located on the banks of the Tamiraparani river.

AboutDescription: Tiruppur City Municipal Corporation is known as the Knitwear Capital of India. It contributes significantly to India's textile exports. Located in western Tamil Nadu it is one of the fastest growing cities in the country.

Erode City Municipal Corporation is known as the Textile City and Turmeric City of India. It is situated on the banks of the Cauvery and Bhavani rivers. The city is a major hub for cotton and turmeric trade in South India.
Vellore City Municipal Corporation governs the historic city of Vellore known for the Vellore Fort
column19: and CMC Hospital. The city is an important educational and medical hub in Tamil Nadu.

AboutDescription: Thoothukudi (Tuticorin) Municipal Corporation governs the major port city of southern Tamil Nadu. It is known for its pearl fishing
column19: and V.O. Chidambaranar Port. The city played a significant role in India's freedom struggle.

AboutDescription: Dindigul Municipal Corporation governs the city known for its rock fort and Dindigul Lock industry. It is also famous for its biryani and leather goods production.

Thanjavur Municipal Corporation governs the cultural capital of Tamil Nadu. Known as the Rice Bowl of Tamil Nadu it is famous for the UNESCO World Heritage Site Brihadeeswara Temple. It is also known for Tanjore paintings and Carnatic music.
Ranipet Municipal Corporation is a major industrial city known for its leather processing industry. It is one of the leading leather goods manufacturing centres in India.
Nagercoil Municipal Corporation governs the southernmost corporation city in India. Located near the southern tip of India it is known for the Nagaraja temple and beautiful coastal landscapes.
Hosur Municipal Corporation is the industrial twin city of Bengaluru. It hosts major industries including TATA Electronics TVS Motor and Biocon. It is one of the fastest growing cities in Tamil Nadu.

Avadi Municipal Corporation is located near Chennai and is known for the Heavy Vehicles Factory (HVF) and Combat Vehicles Research and Development Establishment (CVRDE). It is an important industrial and defence hub near Chennai.

Tambaram Municipal Corporation is a satellite city of Chennai. It is a major residential and commercial hub with significant transport connectivity as it is home to a major Indian Air Force base and railway junction.

Bhavani Municipality is situated at the sacred confluence of the rivers Cauvery and Bhavani in Erode district. The town is known for the Bhavani Sangamam and the ancient Sangameswarar Temple. It is a Grade III municipality with textile and agricultural trade.

Gobichettipalayam (Gobi) Municipality is located in Erode district near the Karnataka border. The town is known for cotton trade sugarcane cultivation and a major railway junction. The nearby Sathyamangalam Tiger Reserve makes it a gateway to forest tourism.

Sathyamangalam Municipality is the gateway to the Sathyamangalam Tiger Reserve (STR) and Biligiri Rangaswamy Temple Tiger Reserve. The town is surrounded by the Nilgiris Biosphere Reserve and is known for eco-tourism and the famous Bhavani Sagar Dam nearby.

Perundurai Municipality is an industrial hub in Erode district. It hosts the SIPCOT Industrial Estate and is known for textile manufacturing power looms and engineering industries. It is one of the fastest growing urban centres in Erode district.
Anthiyur Town Panchayat is located near the Karnataka border in Erode district. It is surrounded by the Sathyamangalam forest and is known for cotton cultivation. The Kaveri river flows nearby.

Nambiyur Town Panchayat is a small agricultural town in Gobichettipalayam taluk of Erode district. It is known for sugarcane and cotton farming and is part of the semi-arid western belt of Erode district.

Kodumudi Town Panchayat is known for the famous Muruganathaswamy Temple located on a natural island in the Cauvery river. The temple is a major pilgrimage site attracting thousands of devotees especially during the Panguni Uthiram festival.

Kavindapadi Town Panchayat is located in Gobichettipalayam taluk of Erode district. The area is part of the sugarcane belt and is known for agricultural produce. It is connected to Gobichettipalayam town via the NH-544.

Thindal Town Panchayat is located on the outskirts of Erode city. It is known for the historic Muruganar Temple at Thindal which is an important pilgrimage site. The area is a growing residential suburb of Erode.
Veerappanchatram Town Panchayat is a textile town near Erode city known for its weaving and dyeing industries. It is part of the greater Erode textile belt and is well connected to the city centre.
Sivagiri Town Panchayat is located in Perundurai taluk of Erode district. The area is known for handloom weaving and agricultural activities. It is near the industrial SIPCOT area of Perundurai.

Modakkurichi Town Panchayat is located on the outskirts of Erode city. The town is a residential and commercial suburb known for coconut and groundnut farming. It is well connected to Erode city via NH 544.
Vellakoil Town Panchayat is a growing town in Perundurai taluk of Erode district. It is known for handloom and textile activities and serves as a commercial centre for surrounding villages.

Thalavadi Town Panchayat is a hill town bordering Karnataka in Erode district. It is part of the Sathyamangalam Tiger Reserve buffer zone and is home to several tribal communities. The area is known for coffee and spice cultivation.

Bhavani Sagar Town Panchayat is located near the famous Bhavani Sagar Dam which is one of the longest earthen dams in Asia. The dam is situated on the Bhavani river and provides irrigation to large areas in Erode district.

Attur Municipality is a Grade III municipality located in Salem district. It is the headquarters of Attur taluk and is known for paddy cultivation and trade. The town is also known for the historic Krishnapuram Palace and its textile market.

Address: Municipal Office, Mettur Dam Road, Mettur - 636401
AboutDescription: Mettur Municipality is located on the banks of the Cauvery river and is known for the famous Mettur Dam (Stanley Reservoir) which is one of the largest reservoirs in India. The area has significant hydroelectric power generation and industrial activity.

Omalur Municipality is an industrial town in Salem district. It is known for the Omalur SIPCOT Industrial Estate and various engineering and manufacturing industries. The town is a significant commercial centre in the Salem-Dharmapuri corridor.

Sankari (Sankaridrug) Municipality is located in Salem district near the Erode border. The town is known for the Sankaridrug Fort (Sankagiri Fort area) which is a historic fortification. It is also known for handloom silk weaving and cotton textiles.

Sankagiri Municipality is a Grade III municipality in Salem district Tamil Nadu. The town is famous for the historic Sankagiri Fort which was an important fortress during the Vijayanagara Empire and later held by Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan. It is also known for handloom silk weaving and cotton textiles.

Edappadi (Idappadi) Municipality is located in the Salem district. The town gained national prominence after former Chief Minister O. Panneerselvam and AIADMK leader Edappadi K. Palaniswami are associated with this region. It is known for mango orchards and silk weaving.
Gangavalli Municipality is a small urban body in Salem district known for paddy cultivation and trade. The town has a weekly market that serves the surrounding villages and agricultural belt.

Tiruchengode Municipality is located in Namakkal district and is the world's largest manufacturer of lorry bodies. The town is also known for the Ardhanareeswarar Temple atop a rocky hill and the Magudanchavadi quarry area.

Yercaud Town Panchayat is a scenic hill station in Salem district situated at 1515 metres above sea level in the Shevaroy Hills. Known as the Poor Man's Ooty it is famous for coffee cultivation rose gardens and the annual summer festival.

Valapady Town Panchayat is in Salem district near Edappadi. The area is known for mango orchards and agricultural produce. It is a small commercial centre for the surrounding villages in the Salem-Erode corridor.
Nangavalli Town Panchayat is in the Attur taluk area of Salem district. The area is primarily agricultural known for paddy and mango cultivation.

Thalaivasal Town Panchayat is located in Salem district. The area is known for sericulture (silk cultivation) and agricultural activities. It serves as a small commercial hub for the Attur taluk interior.
Konganapuram Town Panchayat is in Salem district on the Salem-Coimbatore highway corridor. The area is known for weaving industries and agricultural trade serving as a transit town in the region.

Panamarathupatti Town Panchayat is on the outskirts of Salem city and is one of the faster growing suburban towns. Known for textile and small-scale industries it is part of the greater Salem urban agglomeration.
Malliyakarai Town Panchayat is in the Attur taluk of Salem district. The small town is known for paddy cultivation and traditional crafts. It has a weekly market serving surrounding villages.
